task: Wire the proxy leg of cursor-ide OTLP event-hook forwarding to the CodeMie backend as a PoC no-op passthrough with fire-and-forget push and scaffolding stubs for metrics/logs/traces.

key_reasoning.reason: OtlpIngestInterceptor gains a constructor, transformToEventHookRecord, pushToBackend, and three no-op stub methods, plus a small CODEMIE_ENDPOINTS addition in sso.http-client.ts — 2 components in the same proxy-plugin/SSO-client tier, both patterns clearly established (SSOSessionSyncPlugin.createInterceptor, forwardOtlpEvent).

Fire-and-forget fetch and credentials-resolution are directly copyable from existing precedent (forwardOtlpEvent, SSOSessionSyncPlugin), but the specific combination — unconditionally-registered plugin with optional backend connectivity and no ConfigurationError gate — has no exact precedent in this repo, and otlp-ingest.plugin.ts has zero existing test coverage, so a thrown error inside the new code could regress the working local-JSONL-append 202 response into a 500 if the 'never throws' contract slips.
